cases.sentence: ___ начал богатеть, у него теперь были большие стада, а также служанки, слуги, верблюды и ослы.
cases.translation: Jacob began to grow rich; he now had large flocks, as well as maidservants, menservants, camels, and donkeys.
cases.explain: Иаков is the subject of 'начал', so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Так она дала ему в жены свою ___ Валлу.
cases.translation: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob lay with her.
cases.explain: The verb дать (to give) takes its direct object, служанку, in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Рахиль сказала Лии, «Пожалуйста, дай мне несколько ___ твоего сына».
cases.translation: Rachel said to Leah, 'Please give me some of your son's mandrakes.'
cases.explain: The quantifier несколько (some/several) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Валла, служанка Рахили, снова забеременела и родила ___ второго сына.
cases.translation: Bilhah, Rachel's servant, conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
cases.explain: The verb родить (to bear a child to someone) takes its indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Во время брачной поры, когда животные приходили пить, они спаривались перед ___, и потомство рождалось пестрым, крапчатым или пятнистым.
cases.translation: During the mating season, when the animals came to drink, they mated in front of the branches, and the offspring were born streaked, speckled, or spotted.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (in front of) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: «Если я нашел милость в твоих ___, прошу тебя, останься».
cases.translation: 'If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay.'
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: После того, как Рахиль родила Иосифа, Иаков сказал ___, «Отпусти меня, чтобы я мог вернуться в родные края.
cases.translation: After Rachel bore Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, 'Send me away, that I may return to my own country.'
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to say to someone) takes its indirect object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Иаков стал жить и с Рахилью, и любил Рахиль больше, чем ___.
cases.translation: Jacob began to live with Rachel too, and he loved Rachel more than Leah.
cases.explain: Лию is the direct object of 'любил' (loved), which requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Она сказала Иакову, «Дай мне детей, или я умру».
reading.question: What did Rachel demand from Jacob out of jealousy of her sister?
reading.explain: Rachel said to Jacob, 'Дай мне детей, или я умру' (Give me children, or I will die).

reading.ru: Иаков разгневался на нее и сказал, «Разве я бог, который не дает тебе детей?»
reading.question: How did Jacob respond to Rachel's demand?
options: He grew angry and asked if he were God, who withholds children
He agreed immediately to find her a servant
He wept and prayed for her
He sent her away in anger
reading.correct: He grew angry and asked if he were God, who withholds children
reading.explain: Jacob became angry and asked, 'Разве я бог, который не дает тебе детей?' (Am I God, who withholds children from you?).

reading.ru: Тогда Рахиль сказала, великой борьбой боролась я с моей сестрой и победила, и она назвала его Нефалим.
reading.question: Why did Rachel name Bilhah's second son Naphtali?
options: Because she said she had struggled with her sister and won
Because he was born at night
reading.correct: Because she said she had struggled with her sister and won
reading.explain: Rachel said she had wrestled a great struggle with her sister and won, and named him Naphtali.

reading.ru: Тогда Лия сказала, какая удача, и она назвала его гад.
reading.question: What did Leah say when Zilpah bore Jacob a son, leading her to name him Gad?
reading.explain: Leah said 'какая удача' (what good fortune) and named the son Gad.

reading.ru: Рахиль сказала Лии, «Пожалуйста, дай мне несколько мандрагор твоего сына».
reading.question: What did Rachel ask Leah for after Reuben found mandrakes in the field?
reading.explain: Rachel asked Leah to give her some of her son's mandrakes.

reading.ru: «Хорошо», — сказала Рахиль, «пусть он ляжет с тобой сегодня ночью в обмен на мандрагоры твоего сына».
reading.question: What did Rachel offer Leah in exchange for the mandrakes?
reading.explain: Rachel agreed that Jacob would lie with Leah that night in exchange for the mandrakes.

reading.ru: Тогда Лия сказала, «Бог вознаградил меня за то, что я дала мужу мою служанку», и она назвала его Иссахар.
reading.question: Why did Leah name her fifth son Issachar?
options: Because she said God rewarded her for giving her servant to her husband
Because he was born on the Sabbath
reading.correct: Because she said God rewarded her for giving her servant to her husband
reading.explain: Leah said God had rewarded her for giving her servant to her husband, and named him Issachar.

reading.ru: Тогда Бог вспомнил Рахиль, он услышал ее и открыл ей утробу, она забеременела и родила сына, и сказала, Бог снял мой позор.
reading.question: What happened when God finally remembered Rachel?
options: She conceived and bore a son, saying God had taken away her disgrace
She adopted one of Leah's sons
She remained barren but was comforted
reading.correct: She conceived and bore a son, saying God had taken away her disgrace
reading.explain: God remembered Rachel, opened her womb, and she bore a son, saying He had taken away her reproach.

reading.ru: После того, как Рахиль родила Иосифа, Иаков сказал Лавану, «Отпусти меня, чтобы я мог вернуться в родные края.
reading.question: What did Jacob ask of Laban after Joseph was born?
options: To be released to return to his own country
To be given a permanent house
reading.correct: To be released to return to his own country
reading.explain: Jacob asked Laban to send him away so he could return to his own country.

reading.ru: Позволь мне обойти все твои стада и отделить оттуда всех крапчатых и пятнистых овец, всех темных ягнят и всех пятнистых и крапчатых козлов.
reading.question: What wages did Jacob propose to take from Laban's flocks?
options: The speckled, spotted, and dark-colored animals
A fixed sum of silver each year
reading.correct: The speckled, spotted, and dark-colored animals
reading.explain: Jacob proposed taking all the speckled and spotted sheep and dark lambs and speckled and spotted goats as his wages.

reading.ru: Иаков нарезал свежих веток тополя, миндаля и чинары и сделал на них белые полоски, сняв кору и обнажив белое дерево внутри.
reading.question: What did Jacob do with fresh branches to influence the breeding of the flocks?
options: He peeled white streaks into them and placed them at the watering troughs
He burned them as an offering
He fed them to the strongest animals
He built a fence with them
reading.correct: He peeled white streaks into them and placed them at the watering troughs
reading.explain: Jacob cut fresh branches, peeled white streaks into them, and set them at the watering troughs.
